name: Agent Stack
description: Open infrastructure from the BeeAI project for running AI agents as services, with a CLI, web UI and reference agents.
whatItDoes: Agent Stack lets developers run bundled reference agents such as a chat agent, or package their own from any framework, then call them over HTTP from an application. Formerly known as BeeAI Platform.
howItWorks: A local platform hosts agents as Agent2Agent (A2A) protocol services and provides model routing, a web interface and a CLI to list, inspect and run agents. A starter repo scaffolds new agents.
run: agentstack run chat "Hi, who are you"
models: Multiple providers configured in the platform
